title: New Aircrafts & Stunning Liveries in MSFS2024 Marketplace! ✈️✨ | Weekly Update | Week 47
description:
🔍 Description
🚀Only one new aircraft and one new livery have arrived in the marketplace. The Aeroprakt A-32 Vixxen is a great addition, featuring four variants included in the package. There’s also a livery pack for the MH60 helicopter and an add-on that brings Simbrief integration to the default 737 Max.🌍🛫

📹 Other marketplace additions
If you are looking for either the new training missions or new enhanced scenery and enhanced airports review the respective video by clicking on one if the links below:

- New enhanced scenery and airports: https://youtu.be/PpvZLTUHpZ4
